changelog:
Exchange skill now supports real-time and historical exchange rate queries.

- Added support for real-time basic and cross-currency quotation queries
- Added support for querying historical bank exchange rates and historical forex price trends
- Documentation now details advanced usage, including new `/realtime`, `/bankhistory`, `/history`, and `/history2` commands
- Expanded recommended usage examples for real-time and trend queries
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file
display_name: Exchange Rate Inquiry & Conversion - 汇率查询
summary: 货币汇率换算、热门汇率、货币列表、银行外汇牌价、实时行情及历史汇率等。当用户说：100 美元换多少人民币？今天中行美元现汇价？美元人民币最近一周走势？美元指数多少？或类似汇率换算问题时，使用本技能。
